record.issue_text: packages/core/EventManager.ts:339 — createAllCalendarEvents does not dedupe destinations, so when the event-type destination and a collective host's personal destination resolve to the same credential/externalId two identical events are created in that calendar.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents` now iterates `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` and calls `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)` for each entry when `destination.credentialId` is present. There is no deduplication by `(credentialId, externalId)` (or even by credential alone). Separately, in `handleNewBooking.ts` the event’s `destinationCalendar` array is built from the event type/organizer destination and then, for COLLECTIVE team events, additional hosts’ `user.destinationCalendar` values are appended (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`). If two destinations resolve to the same underlying calendar (same credential and externalId), the loop will create two events in that same calendar, producing duplicate calendar events.
